create.name: New Zealand Community for Christian Meditation (NZCCM)
create.bio:
The New Zealand Community for Christian Meditation is the national community of the World Community for Christian Meditation in Aotearoa, run as a charitable trust with a national coordinator. It follows the teaching of John Main, a Benedictine who recovered a simple contemplative discipline from the early Church: meditating twice a day, sitting still and silently repeating one prayer word. The community stresses that it welcomes people of all faiths and sees the weekly group as the heart of its life.

Groups meet in towns from Northland to Otago, with online groups for those far from one. Regions hold community days on themes that feed the practice, such as an Auckland day in Pukekohe on Jesus' teaching about family, and the community runs a national silent retreat, in 2027 led by the Camaldolese monk Cyprian Consiglio at the University of Waikato. It is also part of a joint pilgrimage retreat with Australia at Bonnevaux in France. Its website offers a guide to meditating and a plan for a one-day retreat at home.

courses.title: Who Is My Family? - Auckland Community Day
courses.description: A community day at St Patrick's, Pukekohe, with meditation and a contemplative talk by Fr James Mulligan on Jesus' teaching about family.

courses.title: The Heart of Christian Spirituality: NZCCM Silent Retreat with Fr Cyprian Consiglio
courses.description: The national silent retreat at the University of Waikato in Hamilton, led by the Camaldolese monk Cyprian Consiglio, for new and experienced meditators.
courses.price: $490 NZD standard; $300 NZD reduced; $590 NZD gifting

courses.title: Bonnevaux Australia and New Zealand National Community Retreat
courses.description: A five-day residential pilgrimage retreat at Bonnevaux Abbey in France with daily meditation, walks and silence.

free_resources.description: A plan for spending a quiet day of meditation and reflection at home.

free_resources.description: A finder for weekly meditation groups around New Zealand and online.
